note: Rolling 6x6 m local costmap, world-aligned and centred on the robot. Footprint/inflation radii are read from the factory navigation map (body radius = inscribed, body + sway + pose error + margin = inflation); people get human_extra_m more. Observations older than their memory fall back to UNKNOWN, never to FREE. Off by default; enable with --costmap or --costmap-debug. Output only: not read by navigation, the safety supervisor or locomotion.
